metadata.Name: MTNT
metadata.Description: The dataset contains noisy sentences collected from Reddit in English, French, and Japanese, along with manual translations for a subset of the data. It is designed to be a more challenging benchmark for machine translation systems when dealing with non-standard text.
metadata.Paper Title: MTNT: A Noisy Text Benchmark for Machine Translation
metadata.Abstract: We introduce MTNT, a new benchmark for machine translation of noisy text. MTNT is a parallel corpus of approximately 15k sentence pairs in English, French and Japanese, collected from Reddit. We show that MTNT contains more noise than existing MT benchmarks, and that it is more representative of naturally occurring noise. We also provide monolingual corpora for each language, which can be used for language modeling or semi-supervised training.
